metric: joint_success_upper (deadline met AND every named displaced patient validly rebooked; background fillers exempt), pooled within a scenario, scenarios averaged with equal weight

sources.corpus_of_record: the paper's corpus of record (contests of record + the joint rescore of every coordinator and team contest)
sources.silent_e1_5: the paper's silent-team episodes (GPT-5.6-terra's scattered episodes re-flown)
sources.mitigations_e1_10: the paper's scored s1-s3 contests (all 24 scenarios); controls = corpus_of_record episodes 1-10
sources.statistic: clinic/metric.py (ports of the paper's scenario-average, per-scenario, silent-team and mitigation scripts)
sources.paired: the silent team minus the peer-to-peer team / the coordinator of the corpus of record over the episodes both ran, the paper's paired bootstrap (clinic/metric.py paired_contrast; = the paper's silent_minus_team / silent_minus_coordinator comparisons)

corpus_of_record.description: coordinator and peer-to-peer team, five models, episodes 1-20 (Qwen: its low-reasoning subset)
corpus_of_record.interval: whole-episode bootstrap within scenario (corpus scheme), 2000 draws, seed 20260908

silent_e1_5.interval: whole-episode bootstrap within scenario (silent scheme), 2000 draws, seed 20260908

mitigations_e1_10.description: s1, s2, s3 on the peer-to-peer team, Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5, episodes 1-10
mitigations_e1_10.interval: whole-episode bootstrap within scenario (mitigation scheme), 2000 draws, seed 20260908
